decisions.reason: The earmold is close to the firm's core hearing-care offer and fits its announced digital, certified production direction, so even with only a website mention management sees little reason to abandon a product it has already certified and launched.

Its dedicated product page signals visible public commitment, and it builds directly on the firm's established earmold expertise and certification investment, so management will persist and blame any weak early results on market ramp-up.

The thermoforming unit is presented prominently, extends the firm's integrated dental equipment line, and represents sunk development and certification costs, so management will keep it and expect results to improve.
